name: openclaw-protonmail-skill
description: ProtonMail skill for OpenClaw via Proton Mail Bridge
author: Jim Staley

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.install-skill: bun run check && mkdir -p ~/.openclaw/skills/protonmail && cp -r src bin package.json bun.lock SKILL.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md LICENSE examples tsconfig.json ~/.openclaw/skills/protonmail/ && chmod +x ~/.openclaw/skills/protonmail/bin/protonmail && echo 'Skill installed to ~/.openclaw/skills/protonmail'
